{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of enrolled patients
enrolled_patients = len(df_clean)

# Confirm no duplicates
assert df_clean['patient_id'].nunique() == enrolled_patients, "Duplicate patient_id found after deduplication"

# Print result
enrolled_patients"}
